title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Every entry, exit, count and percentage below is paper. One trade says nothing about a strategy, and the live record is short.

## What the record is and what it is not

The live record is the engines' own state read from the running record. It shows what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. It does not show real orders, real fills, or real capital at risk. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. htf-rsi-v007 has no live start date in this record, so none is stated here. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The exit rule was met when the price moved from 2.066 to 1.703, and the measurement of that closed trade is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.

## Open positions and the market filter

At the snapshot read at 2026-11-10T02:51:26.898Z, htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v005. The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v006. The record does not state a market filter status for htf-rsi-v007, so none is stated here. The measurement is 0 positions open on paper for v005 and v006 at the same snapshot where their Bitcoin market filters are off. The record shows that state; it does not show why the filter is off.

## Closed trades so far

htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The ATOM trade is the closed trade described in this record: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, exit below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, and a result of -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule was an exit below the 10-day low; the measurement was an exit at 1.703 versus an entry at 2.066; the result was -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. These are paper results. They are short samples, and the record does not support a conclusion about future performance.

## Distance to 20-day breakouts

For trend-daily-v005, the closest names to their 20-day breakout are UNIUSDT at 8.40% below its high, BNBUSDT at 9.00% below its high, and TRXUSDT at 9.82% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, the same three names are closest to their 20-day breakout: UNIUSDT at 8.40% below its high, BNBUSDT at 9.00% below its high, and TRXUSDT at 9.82% below its high. The rule looks for a 20-day breakout at the high; the measurements are 8.40%, 9.00% and 9.82% below that high. These distances describe how far each name is from the breakout level under the stated rule. They do not predict whether a breakout will occur.

## Where the same numbers appear

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the counts and distances above reflect the snapshot read at 2026-11-10T02:51:26.898Z. Later snapshots may differ. This note reports the record as it stands and makes no projection.
